g.title: VarkaIRDataFlow
g.text: Varka IR: data flow between nodes

Left: where a value can come from. Middle: every operator with one port per input component. Right: what each operator produces, and where it can go next - a produced value feeds the matching source on the left (dotted), so any date-valued node can be the input of any node with a date port. Colours: green = date lanes, amber = int field lanes, blue = a stored int column, magenta = an int32 column the evaluator derives per batch from a string column (a leaf), grey = a literal slot, violet = a condition (mask pair). Branch varka-task-61, 5 Sep 2026.

g.title: Hdate
g.text: ColumnRef over a date column, a date LiteralSlot,
or the output of a date-valued node

g.title: Hlit
g.text: day offset, month count (bounded), weekday k, date, compare literal

g.title: Hintcol
g.text: ColumnRef over a stored int column:
day offset (38), month count with a runtime guard (60)

g.title: Hderived
g.text: ColumnRef the evaluator fills per batch:

g.title: TruncDate
g.text: task 35; level is an enum, not an input

g.title: Hint
g.text: the output of an int-valued node, or an int literal
(a bare int column is not admitted here)

g.title: Hmask
g.text: the output of a Cond node

g.title: Sink1
g.text: an int32 Arrow column (date or int) plus its validity

g.title: Sink2
g.text: a Cond as the root: the filter's rows (task 21)
